metadata.description: Corrected FAL image generation prompts for inconsistent/regenerated images. Each prompt enforces canonical character consistency.
metadata.character_consistency_enforcement: All prompts MUST reference the canonical character sheet and specify exact character descriptions. No deviations in species, clothing, or star emblem placement.

canonical_character_spec.elara: Elara - a HUMAN GIRL explorer/astronaut. Long, wavy shoulder-length blonde/light-brown hair with side part and bangs. Wears a wide-brimmed SPACE HELMET/safari hat with band and small front light. White/light-grey BULKY SPACESUIT with high collar. STAR EMBLEM: five-pointed star PATCH on the LEFT CHEST (viewer's left). Belt with large rectangular silver buckle. Holding star-shaped medallion in hand when relevant. NO animal tails, NO civilian dresses - always astronaut/safari uniform.
canonical_character_spec.ziva: Ziva - a CATICORN (cat body + unicorn horn). Furry feline body with pointed triangular CAT EARS (pink interior). Single SPIRAL GOLDEN-YELLOW unicorn horn on forehead. Pink fur on back/head/outer ears, WHITE fur on chest/muzzle/front paws/tail tip. Large anime-style eyes with star highlights. Long FLUFFY tail curling upward. Sitting upright, paws tucked in front. NEVER a horse/pony, NEVER a goat, NEVER human.
canonical_character_spec.teddy_bot: Teddy Bot - an ANTHROPOMORPHIC ROBOT WOLF. Metallic/silver plating body. WOLF-LIKE snout with black nose and toothy smile. Pointed TRIANGULAR ROBOTIC EARS. Large CIRCULAR VISOR eyes. Rectangular chest plate with small inset. Large rounded SHOULDER PAULDRONS with bolts. Segmented mechanical ARMS with CLAW-LIKE grips. NO teddy bear face, NO retro robot screen face, NO dog snout - must be wolf-like.
canonical_character_spec.star_emblem: STAR EMBLEM: Five-pointed star, always on LEFT CHEST as a PATCH (not necklace medallion). Glowing with radial sparkles. Present on Elara's spacesuit.
canonical_character_spec.star_medallion_action: When characters HOLD star-shaped medallions (scene-specific action), they are separate glowing five-pointed stars, NOT replacements for the chest patch.
